requirements: R1: The continuous integration build pipeline and Dockerfiles must be patched to execute tests by removing the '-DskipTests' flag.
R2: The pull request approval gating logic must be updated to reject placeholder or auto-generated approvals that lack substantive critique or logic.

slices.title: Enforce test execution and genuine code reviews
slices.jtbd: When implementing the pipeline fixes for this epic, I want to remove test bypassing and enforce review criteria, so that automated code review integrity is achieved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a Dockerfile or pipeline configuration
When the build command is executed
Then it must not contain the '-DskipTests' flag and all tests must run.
Given a pull request submission
When an automated review is generated
Then it must be rejected if it lacks genuine reasoning, and accepted only if it contains substantive logic.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce the rate of bypassed test executions and faked approvals from >0% to 0%.
